I'm weighing whether to add a third house on Boardwalk for $200, estimating both opponents' total liquid assets against the resulting rent to see if it could actually bankrupt someone versus just dent their cash. p1's pink monopoly with three houses also poses a real threat to me, so I want to keep enough reserve cash while still pushing for the kill on Boardwalk.

Comparing costs, Illinois at 2 houses runs $300 versus similar pricing for Indiana, so I'll go with Illinois for the stronger rent potential.
